reader_summary.overview: Annie Duke is a renown public speaker and decision strategist. For two decades, she was one of the top poker players in the world. Her study of the science of smart decision-making began with a National Science Foundation Fellowship, which she used study Cognitive Psychology at the University of Pennsylvania.

key_points.text: For two decades, she was one of the top poker players in the world.
Among her charity work and television appearances, Annie was a runner-up to Joan Rivers on Celebrity Apprentice.
She is a natural teacher and storyteller with an active mind that constantly searches for accurate truth.
